slides.title: 3 villages that feel like another planet
slides.body: the ones that made me forget the sea — swipe

slides.title: Kalpa
slides.body: Opened my window and the whole Kinnaur Kailash range was gold. Still not over that morning.
Stay up in old Kalpa, not Reckong Peo. Walk to Roghi for the viewpoint — knees shaking, so worth it.

slides.title: Chitkul
slides.body: the last village before the Indo–Tibet border. The road literally just ends here.
Cleanest air I’ve ever breathed, the Baspa roaring, and the kind of quiet that makes you put the phone down.
Chai at the last dhaba of Hindustan, feet by the river. Go May–October, before the snow shuts the road.

slides.title: Tosh
slides.body: where Parvati valley runs out of road and you finally just… stop.
Slow mornings, chai with a snow-peak in your face, nowhere to be. Didn’t check the time once.

slides.title: Which one are you saving for 2027?
slides.body: tell me below, and save this — future you will thank you.
